items.question: What is the ordered sequence of ritual elements directed toward Paśupati after the mudrās?
items.inference: the verse prescribes poison then kūrca then offering to Paśupati thereafter
uncertainties: exact ritual function of kūrca unresolved
whether viṣaṃ is literal or symbolic unresolved
items.plain_english: Poison, then kūrca, then to Paśupati, and after that.
